plan.notes: Source: TMCC official catalog 'Secondary Education, AA' (https://catalog.tmcc.edu/degrees-certificates/secondary-education-aa/), 'Recommended Course Schedule' plan-of-study grid (Secondary Education Career Map), hand-transcribed 2026-10-02. Grid rows shown only as a footnote number with units (1, 4, 5, 6) do not name a specific course in the published schedule — modeled as choice slots with the catalog's footnote number preserved in choice_note; footnotes 4, 5, 6 are not defined on this page and footnote 1 concerns English placement (students placing into ENG 102/114 take additional elective units); see advisor. Students must also select a teaching major and complete some of its coursework prior to transfer; students transferring to UNR take units in their teaching major — see an advisor. Per-course prerequisites are not listed in the schedule grid.
